title: Buffon 2006: two goals conceded, still second
checked: Buffon conceded 2 at WC 2006, a Zaccardo own goal v USA and Zidane's penalty in the final (FIFA, Ghanamma, Sportskeeda); Yashin Award (Liquisearch, Sportskeeda); final 1-1, Italy 5-3 on pens (FIFA, LJWorld); Juventus relegated to Serie B and stripped of two titles in Calciopoli, Cannavaro left for Real Madrid, Buffon stayed (Wikipedia 2006 Ballon d'Or, filgoal); vote Cannavaro 173, Buffon 124, Henry 121 (Topend, Daily Star), 49-point gap (Paste); Yashin 1963 the only keeper winner (Wikipedia, Foot Africa). Calciopoli is stated only as the sanction on record against the club; no individual is accused.

lines.text: Two goals. That's all Gianluigi Buffon let in at the whole twenty-oh-six World Cup.
And look how they went in. One own goal. One penalty.
The own goal was his own teammate's, against the USA. The penalty was Zidane's, in the final.

scene.heading: HOW BUFFON WAS BEATEN
scene.body: Against the USA: an own goal by Italy's Cristian Zaccardo. In the final: a Zinedine Zidane penalty. No opponent scored past him from open play.

lines.text: One-all in Berlin. Then penalties. Italy won five-three.
World champions. And Buffon took the Yashin Award as the tournament's best keeper.
Back home, chaos. Juventus were relegated to Serie B in the Calciopoli scandal and stripped of two titles.
The captain, Cannavaro, left for Real Madrid. Buffon stayed with Juventus, in the second division.
Cannavaro one hundred and seventy-three. Buffon one hundred and twenty-four. Forty-nine points.
To be fair, Cannavaro was immense that summer. But the wall behind him barely gave anything away.
Only one goalkeeper has ever won the Ballon d'Or. Lev Yashin, in nineteen sixty-three.
Buffon never got closer. Twenty-oh-six was his shot.
A keeper who let in two goals all tournament, and it still wasn't enough.
